comment: Applied idempotently through the plugin's public /agent-team/api contract.
The Engineering Leader deliberately declares no provider/model: the Leader
must not be hardcoded to one vendor. Supply it at provision time, e.g.
Any model configured in Harness Settings -> Models is valid.
No credentials appear here. Providers and their keys stay in Harness.
